subject: Request: Exception for 3-year prepay ramp and deep Y1 discount
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novaai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal review — pricing structure question

Soojin,

Thanks for the proposal and the SOW — we reviewed internally and Procurement has a strong preference for multi-year prepay with a front-loaded discount to offset implementation risk in Y1. High level ask: 3-year agreement, full prepay for Year 1 & Year 2 at signature, with a 45% discount on Year 1 list, 30% on Year 2, 20% on Year 3 (billed as invoice schedule you propose).

Key reasons: we need predictable spend for our board and want all credits to be in year 1/2 to support our integration ramp. We also need a clear ramp schedule for capacity (we expect production traffic to hit 60% of commit by Q4 Y1).

Can you confirm Redwood can meet a 45% Y1 effective discount on the committed units and the proposed prepay billing schedule (we can do wire/ACH)? If not, please propose an alternative that keeps total 3-year committed spend within ~the same NPV. Procurement is pushing for signature before their fiscal close on March 31.

Appreciate a quick response — I’m cc’ing Daniel from Procurement for invoice/logistics.

Best,
Alyssa
Procurement Manager, NovaAI

---
Attachment: NovaAI_ask_summary.pdf (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novaai.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaai.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal review — pricing structure question

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and the urgency. We absolutely want NovaAI as a marquee customer and can be flexible, but a straight 45% Y1 effective discount on committed prepay is outside our standard approval band for a three-year commit. A few data points up front:

- Current proposed list ARR (committed units) is $2,100,000 over 3 years (annualized list: Y1 $800k, Y2 $700k, Y3 $600k) in the current SOW v5.
- Our standard max single-year effective discount without exec sign-off is 30%. Anything above that requires Revenue approval + finance review.

To keep the deal moving toward your March 31 close, I have two options to propose now (both assume full prepay for Y1 and Y2 at signature):

Option A (conservative, fast approval):
- Year 1 prepay: 35% off list (invoice at signature)
- Year 2 prepay: 25% off list (invoice at signature)
- Year 3: 15% off list (annual invoice)
- Total 3-year effective discount ~ 27% NPV

Option B (requires exec exception):
- Year 1 prepay: 45% off list (as requested)
- Year 2 prepay: 30% off list
- Year 3: 10% off list
- Requires approval for total discount > 40% on Y1 effective and non-standard invoicing (Y1+Y2 upfront).

I’m looping in Marissa, Karthik, Laura, and Vivek for the exception in Option B. If we can get a signoff on Option B by end of day Monday (3/22), I can send a redlined SOW and DocuSign for signature and share the invoice schedule. If not, Option A is something we can approve quickly from my side without escalation.

Attaching an updated financial model that shows NPV and cash flows for both options.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nova_financial-model-3y.xlsx, NovaAI_SOW-v5.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal review — pricing structure question — request for exception (Deal: DEAL-2026-0042)

Team — forwarding procurement ask from NovaAI (thread below). Short summary and ask:

- Customer: NovaAI (target close before 3/31)
- Proposed commit: 3-year, $2.1M total list across Y1/Y2/Y3 (details in SOW v5 attached).
- Customer ask: 45% Y1 effective discount + full prepay Y1 & Y2 at signature.
- My recommended path: Approve Option B (full customer ask) only if Revenue+Finance approve an exception; otherwise fall back to Option A (35/25/15) which I can approve locally.

Why consider the exception? NovaAI is a high-visibility logo, integration partner opportunity, and they are willing to sign for two years upfront which materially improves our cash position. But the Y1 effective discount at 45% is above our standard band and increases payback risk if usage under-indexes.

What I need from you:
- Marissa: revenue exception approval (Y1>40% effective) or go/no-go on Option B
- Karthik: high-level sign-off for ARR/discount tradeoff and prioritization (this would set a precedent for large prepay exceptions)
- Laura: confirm finance OK with Y1+Y2 full prepay (cash & revenue recognition impact)
- Vivek: any security/compliance flags in the SOW or billing schedule (we have an on-prem options clause they asked about)

I’ve attached the SOW and a simple model. If we can get a fast decision, I will update the SOW terms and send DocuSign.

Thanks —
Soojin

Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal review — pricing structure question — request for exception (Deal: DEAL-2026-0042)

Thanks for the clear summary, Soojin. I reviewed the model and customer strategic value. Two quick items:

1) Prepay cash is attractive and NovaAI is a good strategic win (integration + marketplace potential).
2) We should protect downside with usage-based true-ups and a minimal clawback if usage is <50% of committed units in Y1.

Decision: Approved — we will grant Option B with the following guardrails:
- Year 1: 45% off list (prepay at signature)
- Year 2: 30% off list (prepay at signature)
- Year 3: 10% off list (annual invoice)
- Add a usage true-up clause: if actual consumption < 50% of committed units in Y1, customer owes a 30% partial rebate of the prepaid amount for Y1 (mechanics to be drafted by Finance).
- Legal to approve final SOW language (Vivek, please loop Legal)
- Finance (Laura), please confirm revenue recognition and cash treatment; treasury to accept ACH/wire schedule proposed by Procurement.

Marissa: please coordinate with Soojin to finalize the redline and move DocuSign ASAP. Soojin — once Legal + Finance OK, send redline & I will sign.

Karthik
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
